key_insight: Lotus AI enrollees had higher chronic condition prevalence than national benchmarks, highlighting chronic care and coordination needs in physician-supervised AI platforms.
clinical_relevance: The enrollee profile suggests these platforms should prioritize chronic disease management, functional disorder pathways, and coordination across providers.
method: Characterized 3,223 enrollees who completed onboarding, messaged the agent, and had linked health records during February–July 2026.
Compared demographics and chronic condition prevalence with national benchmarks.
Examined care fragmentation and service use among enrollees.
evidence_signal: Chronic condition prevalence exceeded 2024 NHIS estimates by 4–7 percentage points across age bands; enrollees with functional disorders had 1.8× as many physician escalations and 2.6× as many laboratory orders, but no more prescriptions.
watch_item: This selected, single-platform observational cohort does not establish clinical benefit, safety, or generalizability to other populations.
paper_title: Enrollees and Early Lessons from an Agentic Healthcare Platform with Physicians in the Loop
